newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to price floating rate notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to price floating rate notes.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday it will price $500 million of short-term floating rate notes on Monday, August 18.
When-issued trading is expected to begin at 0820 hrs EDT (1220 GMT) the following day, it said.
The notes are for settlement Aug 21. Maturity date is Feb 19, 1998. Cusip number is 86387TFE3.
Sallie Mae said the notes will be priced at a spread to the bond equivalent rate of the 91-day Treasury bill, with the interest rate reset the day after each weekly T-bill auction.
